module_roles.fusion.py: Two completed windows; physical/active masks; block-bootstrap reliability; delayed predictive calibration; capped KL projection; disagreement and fallback.
module_roles.proxy.py: Causal recovery baseline; known pending deployments; delay-dependent tangent and geometric upper coefficients; conditional exact proxy increment.
module_roles.coordinator.py: Current per-node resource constraints; distinct gain/cost/intensity; exact or multi-start AO; optional dominance pruning; actual feedback updates.
module_roles.pipeline.py: Decide before feedback; freeze normalization prefix; completed-window scores available only from next slot.
module_roles.live_adapter.py: Backend protocol for actual execution, asynchronous deployment feedback, and no-dispatch admission handling.

timing.completed_window: Window ending at slot b is first usable at b+1.
timing.deployment_delay: A job selected at t with delay delta first enters H_(t+delta); completion is recorded after slot t+delta-1.
timing.pending_gain_forecast: A positive key h identifies a pre-decision known contribution entering H_(t+h).
timing.parameter_update: A recommendation creates no policy deployment and no recovery-state gain.

empirical_status: Executable methodological reference and synthetic functional demonstration; no new manuscript experimental result.
